the development of the retinocolliculus pathway in the mouse.
the development and function of neural systems in vertebrates and invertebrates, with particular emphasis on the development of the retina and its connections to the brain.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the retinal wave activity during early development of the mouse retina is essential for the refinement of the retinocollicar map.

retinal waves play a role in the establishment of retinotopy, and not just refinement.
